# Architecture Artifact Templates

This directory contains templates for creating various enterprise architecture artifacts.
page_texts.2:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/README.md#available-templates]

## Available Templates

- [Architecture Decision Record](architecture-decision-record.md) - Template for documenting architectural decisions
- [Architecture Guidance](architecture-guidance.md) - Template for creating architectural guidance documents
- [Best Practice](best-practice.md) - Template for documenting best practices
- [Guiding Principle](guiding-principle.md) - Template for defining guiding principles
- [Job Description](job-description.md) - Template for architecture role job descriptions
- [Pattern](pattern.md) - Template for documenting architectural patterns
- [Reference Architecture](reference-architecture.md) - Template for reference architecture documentation (generic, not TOGAF ADM-phased)
- [Root Cause Analysis](root-cause-analysis.md) - Template for conducting RCA
- [Standard](standard.md) - Template for defining technical standards
- [White Paper](white-paper.md) - Template for creating white papers

### General TOGAF Architecture Templates (All Domains)

These templates produce TOGAF ADM-phased architecture artifacts for any non-security domain (application, business, infrastructure, information, technology, ITSM/operations, governance). See the [TOGAF Artifact Creation Guidelines](togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md) for GUID numbering, directory layout, authoring order, and metadata field requirements before use.

The full service lifecycle — stages, artifacts, roles (RACI), SDP/SSP traceability, and BDD integration — is documented in [foundation/artifact-lifecycle-framework.md](../../../../foundation/artifact-lifecycle-framework.md).

| Template | ADM Phase | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [ABB Definition](abb-definition-template.md) | Phase B–D | Composite and Component Architecture Building Blocks — all non-security domains |
| [ABB Reference Architecture (RAD)](abb-rad-template.md) | Phase C–D | Reference Architecture Document paired with a Component ABB |
| [BDD Specification](bdd-specification-template.md) | Phase C–E | Behavioral contracts (Given/When/Then) derived from ABB requirements |
| [Solution Building Block (SBB)](sbb-template.md) | Phase E–F | Product-specific realization of a Component ABB |

### Security Architecture Templates (TOGAF-Aligned)

These templates produce TOGAF ADM-phased security architecture artifacts. See the [Security Template Creation Guidelines](security-template-creation-guidelines.md) for GUID numbering, directory layout, and authoring rules before use.

> **Security domain routing**: All security artifacts live in `strategy/guidance/security/` — not in `patterns/security/` or `standards/security/`.

| Template | ADM Phase | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [Security Vision Alignment](security-vision-alignment-template.md) | Phase A | Architecture Vision |
| [Security Capability Descriptions](security-capability-descriptions-template.md) | Phase A–B | Capability Descriptions |
| [Security Capability Map](security-capability-map-template.md) | Phase B | L1/L2 Capability Map |
| [Security ABB Definition](security-abb-definition-template.md) | Phase B–D | Composite and Component Architecture Building Blocks |
| [Security ABB Catalog](security-abb-catalog-template.md) | Phase B–D | ABB traceability catalog |
| [Security Reference Architecture](security-reference-architecture-template.md) | Phase C–D | Reference Architecture Document (RAD) |
| [Security Solution Building Block](security-sbb-template.md) | Phase E–F | Solution Building Block (SBB) |

## Usage

Each template includes:

- Document structure and sections
- Guidance on content to include
- Examples and best practices
- Related artifact references

Select the appropriate template based on the type of artifact you need to create.
